title: Part 3: Navigation & Game Engine
author: J.W.
excerpt: The project matured with proper navigation and evolved beyond a single landing page. A complete point-and-click adventure game framework was built, complete with TypeScript support, percentage-based coordinate system for responsive hitboxes, and state management for inventory and puzzle tracking. The S33K3R TRANSMISSION is no longer just a mystery to observe—it's a world to explore.
